finding: The base gate says a reviewer needs a non-UNCERTAIN bounded frontier. The actual screening question also makes an affirmative YES to known held-preview-body/consumer exposure ineligible; non-UNCERTAIN alone is therefore too broad.
decision: For this exact future documentary duty, only an owner status report of NO known direct access to the named held preview bodies or consumers may pass this preliminary screen. YES or UNCERTAIN means STOP. Even a NO is only a bounded self-report, not a complete exposure census or a blind/clean-cognition certificate; a prospective exact manifest, all admitted inputs and actual pre-body ACK remain mandatory. No helper substitution may recover a held method.
impact: No reviewer was dispatched. The already-performed parent visual source observation is parent-only and not an independent-review finding. Frozen base gate and source images remain unchanged.
limits: All preview, L1, global source preflight outside the exact gate, N4 UNKNOWN historic child exit unestablished and auxiliary214 STOP remain.
